settings.sql:
SELECT current_setting('cron.max_running_jobs') AS job_limit,
       current_setting('cron.use_background_workers') AS worker_mode;

activity.sql:
SELECT pid, backend_type, application_name, state, wait_event
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE application_name IN ('pg_cron', 'pg_cron scheduler')
ORDER BY backend_type, pid;

cleanup.sql:
SELECT cron.unschedule(jobid) FROM cron.job
WHERE jobname IN ('demo-a', 'demo-b');

overlap.sql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.label = b.label) AS same_job_overlaps,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.label <> b.label) AS other_job_overlaps
FROM cron_demo_runs a JOIN cron_demo_runs b
  ON a.id < b.id
 AND tstzrange(a.started, a.finished, '[)')
     && tstzrange(b.started, b.finished, '[)');

peak.sql:
SELECT max(concurrent_jobs) AS peak_jobs
FROM (
  SELECT a.id, count(*) AS concurrent_jobs
  FROM cron_demo_runs a JOIN cron_demo_runs b
    ON b.started <= a.started AND a.started < b.finished
  GROUP BY a.id
) AS observations;
